Specification of Execution Management

The form of identity is implementation specifc but could, for example, be the process
identifier, a cryptographic token, user ID, etc.
Based on implementation requirements,
Execution Management

faces that allow IAM to retrieve information about the association between
process
and

identity. The exact form of this interface is implementation
